paragraphs: “They laughed at it in the West”; see R. Yosi bar Chanina above. “R. Shimon says, etc.” “They laughed at it in the West.” R. Chaga said, “What is there to laugh at?” Rav Pappa and Rav Huna son of Rav Yehoshua said, “This is what is laughable”: Shevuot 34b.
